ValidationRule.description: If Employment Status = Self Employed and Pre screening result = accept then Business sector is mandatory
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
AND( ISCHANGED(cc_Employment_Status__c), ISPICKVAL(cc_Employment_Status__c, "Self Employed"), ISPICKVAL(Business_Sector__c, ""), ($User.LastName <> "Integration"), OR( AND( ISPICKVAL(Type, "Credit Card Application"), ISPICKVAL(Sub_Type__c, "New Credit Card") ), ISPICKVAL(Type, "Credit Limit Increase Application"), ISPICKVAL(Type, "Convert Credit Card Nature Application")
) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please fill the Business Sector field, if Employment status is Self Employed.
